title: Senior Doctors in England Plan Two-Day Strike in November
subtitle: Consultants to walk out over pay and working hours, raising concerns about patient care during the busy winter season.

summary.en: Senior hospital doctors in England, known as consultants, have announced a two-day strike for late November. The decision follows 18 months of unsuccessful talks with the government regarding pay and working hours. The British Medical Association claims that the value of their salaries has fallen significantly since 2010. NHS leaders warn that the walkout will cause pain and inconvenience for patients waiting for treatment. This strike presents a major challenge for the government as it tries to manage tight public finances.
summary.zh: 英國醫院的資深醫師（即顧問醫師）宣布將於十一月下旬進行為期兩天的罷工。此決定是在與政府針對薪資及工時進行十八個月的協商未果後所做出的。英國醫學會聲稱，自二零一零年以來，醫師薪資的實質價值已大幅下滑。國民保健署領導階層警告，罷工將對等待治療的病患造成痛苦與不便。此次罷工對正試圖管理緊縮公共財政的政府而言，是一項重大挑戰。

paragraphs.en: Senior hospital doctors in England, known as consultants, have confirmed they will go on strike for two days next month. The walkout is scheduled for November 25 and 26. This action comes after 18 months of unsuccessful discussions between the government and the British Medical Association (BMA), which represents the doctors. During the strike, consultants will only provide emergency cover, similar to the level of service provided on Christmas Day.
paragraphs.zh: 英國醫院的資深醫師（即顧問醫師）已確認將於下個月發動為期兩天的罷工。此次罷工預計於十一月二十五日及二十六日進行。這項行動是在代表醫師的英國醫學會（BMA）與政府進行長達十八個月且未果的協商後所採取。罷工期間，顧問醫師將僅提供緊急醫療服務，服務水準將與聖誕節當日相當。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the consultants decided to take this action because they are unhappy with their pay and working conditions. The BMA states that the real value of consultant salaries has dropped by 25% since 2009-10. In addition to better pay, the doctors are calling for a 10% reduction in their working hours. The union claims that ministers have ignored concerns about burnout, which is when workers feel exhausted and unable to perform their jobs well due to long-term stress. The BMA described a recent government offer of a 2.4% pay increase as the "last straw," meaning it was the final problem that made them decide to act.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》報導，顧問醫師決定採取此行動，是因為他們對薪資與工作條件感到不滿。英國醫學會指出，自二零零九至二零一零年度以來，顧問醫師薪資的實質價值已縮水百分之二十五。除了要求提高薪資外，醫師們也呼籲將工時減少百分之十。工會聲稱，政府官員忽視了關於職業倦怠的擔憂，即員工因長期壓力而感到精疲力竭，無法妥善執行職務。英國醫學會形容政府近期提出的百分之二點四加薪方案是「壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草」，意指這是促使他們決定採取行動的最後導火線。

paragraphs.en: This decision creates a difficult situation for the government. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is currently trying to improve access to NHS care while managing very limited public funds. The BMA co-chairs, Dr. Helen Neary and Dr. Shanu Datta, explained that they had tried to work with the government in good faith for a long time. They noted that their members have had enough, stating that while striking is not something they want to do, they feel forced to take this step because the government has not offered practical solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 這項決定讓政府陷入困境。首相安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）目前正試圖在管理極其有限的公共資金的同時，改善國民保健署（NHS）的醫療服務取得管道。英國醫學會共同主席海倫·尼里（Helen Neary）醫師與夏努·達塔（Shanu Datta）醫師解釋，他們長期以來一直試圖以誠信態度與政府合作。他們表示會員已忍無可忍，並強調雖然罷工並非他們所願，但由於政府未能提供務實的解決方案，他們感到被迫採取此步驟。

paragraphs.en: NHS leaders have expressed strong concern about the impact of the strike. Ciarán Devane, the head of the NHS Alliance, said he was "astonished and dismayed" by the news. He pointed out that the health service is already struggling to deal with a backlog—a large number of unfinished tasks—of more than 6 million patients waiting for over 7 million treatments. He warned that the walkout will likely force hospitals to postpone or reschedule non-urgent appointments, elective surgeries, and follow-up visits. While these changes are necessary to keep patients safe, Mr. Devane noted that they will likely cause unnecessary pain, discomfort, and inconvenience for many people.
paragraphs.zh: 國民保健署的領導階層對罷工造成的影響表達了強烈擔憂。國民保健署聯盟負責人希亞蘭·德瓦恩（Ciarán Devane）表示，他對此消息感到「震驚與沮喪」。他指出，醫療服務體系目前已難以應付積壓的案件，即超過六百萬名病患等待超過七百萬項治療的龐大待辦事項。他警告，此次罷工很可能迫使醫院推遲或重新安排非緊急預約、選擇性手術及後續回診。儘管這些調整對於確保病患安全是必要的，但德瓦恩先生指出，這很可能會對許多民眾造成不必要的痛苦、不適與不便。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time consultants have taken industrial action, which is when employees stop working to protest against their employer. They previously held nine days of strikes in 2023. However, the timing of this new protest is particularly challenging for hospitals. Winter is usually the busiest time of year for the health service, and hospitals are already preparing for the extra pressure that comes with the colder months. Mr. Devane warned that the strike could throw current plans to improve waiting times off course and cause serious problems for NHS finances.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非顧問醫師首次採取勞工抗爭行動，即員工透過停止工作來向雇主抗議。他們曾在二零二三年舉行過為期九天的罷工。然而，此次抗議的時間點對醫院而言格外棘手。冬季通常是醫療服務體系一年中最繁忙的時期，醫院已在為寒冷月份帶來的額外壓力做準備。德瓦恩先生警告，罷工可能會使目前改善等待時間的計畫偏離軌道，並對國民保健署的財務造成嚴重問題。

paragraphs.en: The situation highlights the ongoing tension between the government and medical staff. While resident doctors—formerly known as junior doctors—recently accepted a deal to end their own long-running campaign of strikes in June, the consultants remain in a dispute. As the government continues to grapple with the demands of the BMA, patients are left waiting to see how these developments will affect their medical care as winter approaches. The government has not yet provided a new offer that satisfies the union, leaving the planned strike for late November as the next major hurdle for the health service.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況凸顯了政府與醫護人員之間持續存在的緊張關係。雖然住院醫師（前稱實習醫師）近期已接受協議，結束了他們自六月起長期進行的罷工行動，但顧問醫師的爭議仍未解決。隨著政府持續應對英國醫學會的要求，病患只能等待觀察這些發展將如何在冬季來臨之際影響他們的醫療照護。政府尚未提出能讓工會滿意的新方案，使得預計於十一月下旬進行的罷工，成為醫療服務體系面臨的下一個重大障礙。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Protection or service provided during an emergency or absence of regular staff.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Away from the intended or planned path.

quiz.question: What level of service will consultants provide during the upcoming two-day strike?

options.A: They will provide full services to ensure no patient appointments are missed.
options.B: They will only provide emergency cover, similar to the service on Christmas Day.
options.C: They will provide all services except for elective surgeries and follow-up visits.
options.D: They will provide limited services only for patients who are already in the hospital.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段最後一句：「During the strike, consultants will only provide emergency cover, similar to the level of service provided on Christmas Day.」選項 A 與文章所述相反，因為他們會罷工；選項 C 雖然提到了手術延遲，但那不是罷工期間提供的服務標準；選項 D 則過於狹隘，未準確描述緊急醫療覆蓋的定義。

quiz.question: Why is the timing of the November strike considered particularly problematic for the NHS?

options.A: Because the government is currently negotiating with junior doctors instead.
options.B: Because it coincides with the end of the fiscal year, affecting the hospital budget.
options.C: Because hospitals are already struggling with a massive backlog of patients.
options.D: Because the winter season increases patient demand, making service disruptions more severe.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章第五段提到：「Winter is usually the busiest time of year for the health service, and hospitals are already preparing for the extra pressure that comes with the colder months.」雖然 C 選項提到積壓的病患（backlog），這是目前的現狀，但文章特別強調「timing」之所以困難，是因為冬季的高需求會讓罷工帶來的影響加劇。選項 A 與罷工時機無直接因果關係；選項 B 文中並未提及。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'backlog' refer to?

options.A: A large number of unfinished tasks or cases that have accumulated over time.
options.B: A financial deficit resulting from poor management of hospital funds.
options.C: A group of patients who have been denied treatment by the government.
options.D: A list of medical staff who are refusing to work extra hours.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文章中提到「a backlog—a large number of unfinished tasks—of more than 6 million patients」，這裡的 backlog 指的是累積下來尚未處理的醫療案件。選項 B 指的是財務赤字，與文中語境不符；選項 C 說病患被拒絕治療並不精確，他們只是在等待；選項 D 則完全偏離了這個詞彙在醫療管理中的定義。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central issue described in the article?

options.A: The government has successfully negotiated a new contract with all medical staff.
options.B: Consultants are striking due to pay and working conditions, creating a significant challenge for the NHS.
options.C: The NHS is planning to cancel all non-emergency services permanently to save money.
options.D: The BMA and the government have reached an agreement to increase consultant salaries by 10%.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文主旨圍繞在資深醫生（consultants）因薪資與工作條件不滿而發起罷工，這對面臨冬季壓力和病患積壓的 NHS 造成了嚴峻挑戰。選項 A 與 D 皆與事實相反，因為目前雙方並未達成協議；選項 C 誇大了罷工的性質，罷工是暫時的抗議行動，而非永久性的政策改變。
